paragraphs.text: In parts of the Andes where rain almost never falls, villages collect water from fog. Large nets made of fine plastic mesh are stretched between two poles on hillsides facing the sea.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: When fog blows through the nets, tiny droplets stick to the mesh and join together until they are heavy enough to run down into a gutter at the bottom. From there, pipes carry the water to storage tanks in the village.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: A single net of 40 square metres can collect around 200 litres on a good day. The amount depends on the season: the thickest fogs occur in winter, when the nets can supply enough water for drinking and small vegetable gardens.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: The nets are cheap to build, but strong winds can tear the mesh, so villagers must check and repair them regularly.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: Similar projects now operate in parts of Morocco and Nepal, and engineers are testing new designs that could collect even more water from lighter fog.
paragraphs.label: E

items.quote: Large nets made of fine plastic mesh

explanation.en: “nets made of fine plastic mesh” → mesh. “Plastic” is already there, and “fine” is not needed: one word.
explanation.kk: «nets made of fine plastic mesh» → mesh. «Plastic» түйінде тұр, ал «fine» керек емес: бір сөз.
explanation.ru: «nets made of fine plastic mesh» → mesh. «Plastic» уже в пересказе, а «fine» не нужно: одно слово.

explanation.en: The nets stand “on hillsides facing the sea”, where the fog comes from. “Hills that face” paraphrases “hillsides facing”, so the answer is sea.
explanation.kk: Торлар «on hillsides facing the sea» орнатылады — тұман теңізден келеді. «Hills that face» — «hillsides facing» дегеннің басқаша айтылымы, жауап sea.
explanation.ru: Сети ставят «on hillsides facing the sea» — туман приходит с моря. «Hills that face» пересказывает «hillsides facing», ответ sea.

items.quote: heavy enough to run down into a gutter at the bottom

explanation.en: “run down into a gutter at the bottom” → gutter. “Tanks” come later and are already in the summary.
explanation.kk: «run down into a gutter at the bottom» → gutter. «Tanks» — жолдың келесі бөлігі, түйінде аталған.
explanation.ru: «run down into a gutter at the bottom» → gutter. «Tanks» — дальше по пути, они уже названы в пересказе.

items.quote: the thickest fogs occur in winter
items.prompt: The most water is collected in 4 ____

explanation.en: The thickest fogs “occur in winter”, when there is enough water for drinking and gardens → winter.
explanation.kk: Ең қою тұман «occur in winter», сол кезде су ішуге де, бақшаға да жетеді → winter.
explanation.ru: Самые густые туманы «occur in winter», и тогда воды хватает на питьё и огороды → winter.

items.quote: villagers must check and repair them regularly

explanation.en: “villagers must check and repair them regularly” → repair. After “check and” we need a verb in the same form.
explanation.kk: «villagers must check and repair them regularly» → repair. «check and» тіркесінен кейін сол түрдегі етістік керек.
explanation.ru: «villagers must check and repair them regularly» → repair. После «check and» нужен глагол в той же форме.
